author: Ogrey
body:
Special thanks to ScriptingLyfe for supplying his build server! :D



Map Name: Carne Vale
Map Creators: Astronis & Flufflepuff_
Gamemode: Nebula - Capture the Wool

Just a plain CTW map with simple gameplay. You spawn with defense supplies yourself so you can defend or just offend if you feel like doing so. There's a bit of water in the map and frontlines have some sort of barrier structure. There's iron farms at the back of the map and it was pretty much built focusing on simplicity rather than huge detail. Hope you enjoy!
